description: This Java class provides the default implementation of the JavaScript mapping configuration, including properties for script size, execution time, and stack depth, with methods for instantiation, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultJavaScriptConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing JavaScriptConfig, encapsulating script size, execution time, and stack depth configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultJavaScriptConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getMaxScriptSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum script size in bytes.

methods.name: getMaxScriptExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum script execution time as a Duration.

methods.name: getMaxScriptStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum script stack depth.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on configuration properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on configuration properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration.
